notes: Cover panel re-shoot of varq-19-neelam: standing, full length, headroom for the tall crop.
prompt: Editorial fashion photograph for an Indian handloom label's festive lookbook. Tall vertical 9:16 frame.
GARMENT (a real product; match the reference photos exactly, including colours, borders and motifs):

- Saree: the deep sapphire-violet mul cotton saree from the first three references, printed with a delicate gold foil jaal of scalloped lines and tiny dots, gold lace edge and navy tassels. Soft, matte, airy.
- Blouse: the magenta silk brocade blouse with tiny gold buttis from the last two references, elbow-length sleeves, V neckline.
- The pallu swirls out as she turns, showing the gold jaal.
MUSE: a young woman in her early twenties with short curly hair, big gold jhumkas, a red bindi, glass bangles, laughing with her head thrown back as she spins.
MOMENT AND PLACE: Diwali night on a terrace: she stands holding a lit sparkler slightly away from her body, rows of diyas on the parapet and soft fireworks bokeh in the city sky behind.
LIGHT: Night, lit by the sparkler and diyas: bright warm sparks, deep blue-violet night around.
COVER FRAMING (this photograph becomes one tall, narrow panel of the lookbook's opening page, behind a large title):
- POSE: she is standing upright, full length, head to toe in frame; ignore any seated or kneeling pose mentioned above.
- HEADROOM: the top quarter of the frame is calm, empty background (sky, wall, foliage or soft darkness); her head sits about a quarter of the way down, never near the top edge.
- Subject centred horizontally and filling the middle third of the width, so a narrow vertical crop keeps all of her.
- Keep the background simple and softly out of focus; nothing busy behind her face.
- CAMERA: eye level, 50mm lens at f/2.8, gentle depth of field, medium-format look with fine grain.
